Name: The Backwood Hill
Author: EvtMax
Description:
[u][b]Some Infos[/b][/u]

Hello there. Welcome to my first own Mod!

I made it so I could learn how Tiled works and making Mods for Stardew Valley in general, so you can expect a few more updates in the future that provide more features.

For now I added this new small little Area The "Backwood Hill".

There is Forage to find and Trees to tap or cut down whatever u prefer! ^^

The Area is designed with the Idea that other Mod Authors can use it to connect their mod near the Backwoods.

Many places in the "Backwood" Area are already occupied by other Mods (When u play like me with 400+ Mods you maybe know how crowded the location can be) for now there are three blocked off paths feel free to ask me when u want to use one of them, I will clear them out and you can use them for a connection to your own Map expansion!
 
[color=#e06666][b]All my work is free to use for everyone!
[/b][/color]

[u][b]How to Install: 

[/b][/u]1. Download the File.

2. Unzip the File with a Tool of your choice.

3. Drag the unzipped File into your mods folder.

4. Enjoy!


[u][b]The Next Update:

[/b][/u]- 1.2 will add more Areas to explore!

[u]
[b]Collaborations:
[/b][/u]
If you would like to see The Backwoodhill on the Map, check out

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29049]Remapping - Minimap Project[/url]

It's worth downloading, especially if you have a lot of mods with new locations!

Thanks again to [b]VIgor[/b] for his work to make this collaboration possible.
